rules: all supported locales normalize into one zh-CN motion frame before retrieval
descriptive Chinese filenames explain the visible motion while stable ids preserve references
action-card positive and negative evidence selects the concrete asset; intent-only random selection is forbidden
only one owner writes the VRM animation mixer
standing rest is selected once and never time-rotated
transient actions crossfade directly into the next action or saved base pose
persistent expression state is independent from body playback
posture actions and recovery transitions require a separately licensed action pack
